label: Suzma
note: In Central Asia strained qatiq (boiled milk set with its own starter), not Greek-style thermophilic yoghurt; Turkish süzme yoğurt is strained ordinary yoghurt

about.text: Strained yoghurt of Central Asia, drained from qatiq until it is thick; in Turkey it is süzme yoğurt, or kese yoğurdu, 'bag yoghurt'. Dried further, it becomes qurut.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Suzma is Central Asian katyk (yoghurt) strained in cloth until thick; dried, it becomes kurut.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.name: hang
steps.note: The katyk (yoghurt) is hung in a cloth bag to drain the whey.
